name: BEWITCHED FOLLOWER

source.reason: Explicit CUR-003 source reference; edition/permission not certified.

originalText:
Bewitched Follower
Most people who belong to Euphobia’s cult come from
the ranks of ordinary people. They discard anything made
from iron and participate in the few required religious
ceremonies, but are otherwise free to go about their lives as
usual.

BEWITCHED FOLLOWER

DIFFICULTY 1

Perception 10 (+0)
Defense 10, Health 5, Insanity 4, Corruption 0
Strength 10 (+0), Agility 10 (+0), Intellect 10 (+0), Will 10 (+0)
Descriptor Human, Size 1, Speed 10
Languages Common Tongue
Iron Liberation If the bewitched follower takes damage from
an object made from iron or one of its alloys, the follower
loses this trait and Warped Loyalty forever.
Warped Loyalty A follower makes Will challenge rolls with 1
bane.
Melee Attack—Club Strength (+0) (1d6)

Fanatic Beloveds
Cries of “No Other Gods!” and “Down with the False Gods!”
fill the air as the fanatics among the Beloved overrun a
community of nonbelievers. The frothing mob ransacks
temples and topples idols. They drag out the priests by
their vestments and tear them to pieces in plain view,
almost as if they were daring the gods to rebuke them.
Their zeal shores up whatever deficiencies they might have
in fighting.
Fanatics wear clothes made from woven grasses, circlets
of flowers on their heads, and sandals. They wield wooden
weapons—clubs and spears—in accordance with their
god’s wishes. She permits no iron within sight of her abode.

name: BELOVED FANATIC

source.reason: Explicit CUR-003 source reference; edition/permission not certified.

originalText:
BELOVED FANATIC

DIFFICULTY 10

Perception 10 (+0)
Defense 12 (large shield), Health 11, Insanity 3, Corruption 1
Strength 11 (+1), Agility 10 (+0), Intellect 9 (–1), Will 10 (+0)
Descriptor Human, Size 1, Speed 10
Languages Common Tongue
Iron Liberation If the fanatic takes damage from an object
made from iron or one of its alloys, make a Will challenge
roll. On a failure, the fanatic loses this trait forever, as well
as Righteous Zeal and Fanatical Effort.
Righteous Zeal A fanatic makes Will challenge rolls with 1
boon.
Melee Attack—Club Strength (+1) with 1 boon (2d6)
Fanatical Effort If the result of the attack roll is a failure,
the fanatic can take 1d3 damage to repeat the attack roll.
If the new result is a failure, the fanatic becomes Stunned
until the end of its next turn.

Apostles of Euphobia
The people who came to the faith after encountering
Euphobia in the woods became her fiercest followers.
Calling themselves apostles, they lead congregations and
offer wisdom and counsel to the other followers. The
apostles endeavor to quell doubts about Euphobia’s divinity
and spend their time encouraging the faithful to be good
and kind.
Apostles wear simple garments, usually green robes
cinched at the waist with a plain length of rope. They wear

4

flowers in their hair and go about barefoot. They usually
carry staffs, mostly ceremonial, as they can wield some
magic to protect themselves.

name: APOSTLE OF EUPHOBIA

source.reason: Explicit CUR-003 source reference; edition/permission not certified.

originalText:
APOSTLE OF EUPHOBIA

DIFFICULTY 15

Perception 12 (+2)
Defense 10, Health 30, Insanity 6, Corruption 1
Strength 10 (+0), Agility 10 (+0), Intellect 12 (+2), Will 10 (+0)
Descriptor Human, Size 1, Speed 10
Languages Common Tongue, Elvish
Permanent Charm An apostle makes Will challenge rolls
with 1 boon. If the apostle becomes Charmed by any
creature other than Euphobia, the Charmed affliction ends
immediately.
Leadership The apostle grants 1 boon to attack rolls made by
allies within short range.
Iron Vulnerability The apostle takes 1d6 extra damage from
weapons made from iron or alloys of iron and becomes
Impaired until the end of their next turn.
Melee Attack—Staff Strength (+0) (1d6)
Join Us The apostle can use an action to target one creature
within short range. If the target can see and hear the
apostle, make an Intellect (+2) attack roll against the
target’s Will. On a success, the target becomes Charmed
by Euphobia and her followers for 24 hours. The affliction
ends early if the target takes any damage from a weapon
made from iron or an iron alloy. This talent counts as a rank
4 spell. Once the apostle uses it, they lose access to it for
24 hours.
Mind Rake The apostle can use an action to target one
creature within medium range. Make an Intellect (+2) attack
roll against the target’s Will. On a success, the target takes
2d6 damage and becomes Dazed until the end of its next
turn.

name: BEWITCHED CHAMPION

source.reason: Explicit CUR-003 source reference; edition/permission not certified.

originalText:
Bewitched Champion
Euphobia elevates those followers who possess some kind
of fighting ability over those who do not. After they rid
themselves of their weapons and armor, she layers them
with magical protections. She inspires in them an obsession
with her that makes them her most loyal devotees.

BEWITCHED CHAMPION

DIFFICULTY 25

Perception 10 (+0)
Defense 17 (faerie mail, large shield), Health 40, Insanity 8,
Corruption 1
Strength 12 (+2), Agility 11 (+1), Intellect 10 (+0), Will 10 (+0)
Descriptor Human, Size 1, Speed 10
Languages Common Tongue
Permanent Charm A champion makes Will challenge rolls
with 1 boon. If the champion becomes Charmed by
any creature other than Euphobia, the affliction ends
immediately.
Serve in Life and Death When the champion’s damage total
reaches their Health score, roll a d6. On a 3 or less, the
champion dies (or suffers some other fate as you decide).
On a 4 or higher, the champion heals 10 damage and then
loses access to this trait for 24 hours.
Iron Vulnerability The champion takes 1d6 extra damage
from weapons made from iron or alloys of iron and
becomes Impaired until the end of their next turn.
Melee Attack—Faerie Sword Strength (+2) with 1 boon (1d6
+ 2)
Two Attacks The champion can use an action to make two
melee attacks.

--- PDF p. 5 ---
A Beloved Campaign
As much as the nymph’s cult serves her vanity, it has no
real sinister motives. Members enjoy themselves and honor
their god. Demonic influences, however, could warp the
cult from its benign nature by corrupting the self-styled god
and twisting her minions toward evil ends. The following is
one way for the Beloved to become an existential threat to
Rûl and beyond.
The entries also include new Shadow of the Demon
Lord effects. They demonstrate how demonic influence
infects the world as a result of the worsening developments
involving this cult.

War of Faith (Novice)
The burning of the Summer Palace put an end to all hopes
for a peaceful coexistence between the Summer Queen’s
faithful and the ascending Beloved cult. That the arson
came on the heels of months of religious persecution
carried out by the upstart cultists left no doubt in anyone’s
minds about who was behind the attack. And while the
ruin of any shrine or holy site would give the aggrieved
reason to take up arms, the Summer Palace stood as the
Queen’s greatest temple in the Northern Reach. As a result,
the priests of Summer gather up sympathetic people to
drive back the fanatic Beloved of Euphobia.
Shadow of the Demon Lord: Humans, except the
Beloved faithful, experience a dulling of their sexual
desires. People find others unattractive and the idea
of copulation unappealing. Agitation spreads through
communities of all kinds. Nothing can ease the growing
tension.

Increasing Atrocities (Expert)
As converts to the Beloved faith shake off the malaise
affecting them, the cult sees a rapid growth across the
Northern Reach. With it comes hostility directed at all
other religious groups. Even the tolerant cultists who
previously had rejected aggression find themselves drawn
into the conflict. Worse, destroying temples and holy relics
proves insufficient for the fanatics among the Beloved.
They start executing anyone who serves any god other than
theirs, usually in a brutal and sadistic fashion.
Shadow of the Demon Lord: Humans who do not
belong to the Beloved faith suffer from a general
malaise. People find they lack the motivation to do
much of anything unless compelled. People stay in
their homes, let the clutter pile up, and abandon their
responsibilities. They eat and drink little. They pass
their days asleep whenever they can.

--- PDF p. 6 ---
The Faerie Queen Usurped
(Master)
After all the years Euphobia resisted transforming into a
hag, she finally succumbs and transforms into a monstrous,
wicked creature whose ugliness of spirit manifests in
her broken form. All the evil committed in her name
has deepened the hate she felt toward the Faerie Queen,
consuming her such that she can think of nothing else but
destroying her rival in a prolonged, excruciating fashion.
In this new form, she gathers up her followers and leads
them to invade Alfheim and the other faerie realms hidden
all over the continent. The blood of both immortal and
mortal alike flows in rivers, and the magic sustaining these
extradimensional places breaks down, enabling routes for
demons to escape from the Void and wreak havoc upon this
world.
Shadow of the Demon Lord: The Beloved develop an
uncontrollable hatred for faeries. They make attack rolls
against faeries with 1 boon, and their attacks against
them deal an extra 1d6 damage. However, no human
can heal damage through natural means, and magical
healing heals half the normal amount of damage.
